items.title: Mid oblique base, day: canyon light, neon on (D41)
items.notes: Batch 2 (~4 Mac-h for day / dusk / night). setting: docs/tiancheng-maps.md s0 (D41); self-check s0.8; no user review. shared camera: ortho, az 165, pitch 35, 0.44 m/px, frame fitted to the tier content and snapped to 16:10; the render writes the camera file (s0.6). Uses the camera locked by obl:tc_upper:day (same orientation and m/px; own frame, deck at z = 50 m). Canyon light: sun on crowns only, streets in shade, soft dark zones under the islands; neon and holograms on at ~40 % of night. Facades and window emissive textures needed (no point lights for windows). register / ship wait for the OBLIQUE-CODE step (maps.json views).  Queue order is enforced by depends: one batch at a time (D20); batches 1-9 in docs/tiancheng-maps.md s0.9.

Light: warm sky, sun on the tallest crowns only, neon ~70 %, windows coming on; also serves the dawn period. register / ship wait for the OBLIQUE-CODE step (maps.json views). items.title: Mid oblique, night (D41)
items.notes: Batch 2. setting: docs/tiancheng-maps.md s0 (D41); self-check s0.8; no user review. Same camera file as obl:tc_mid:day. Light: the whole grid lit, each district in its own character: core warm-gold crowns and white offices, high district clean white with the cathedral floodlit, commercial C densest magenta / cyan neon and holograms, outer residential warm windows with sparse neon, ring barracks floodlights, glowing rail lines with lit trains, car-light streams; only parks, canals and open lots stay dark; self-check s0.8 item 3 (>= 80 % of 250 m cells lit). register / ship wait for the OBLIQUE-CODE step (maps.json views).  Queue order is enforced by depends: one batch at a time (D20); batches 1-9 in docs/tiancheng-maps.md s0.9.

items.title: Low oblique base, day shift: artificial light only (D41)
items.notes: Batch 3 (~3 Mac-h for both shifts). setting: docs/tiancheng-maps.md s0 (D41); self-check s0.8; no user review. shared camera: ortho, az 165, pitch 35, 0.44 m/px, frame fitted to the tier content and snapped to 16:10; the render writes the camera file (s0.6). Same orientation and m/px as the upper camera; ground at z = 0. No sun, no sky light; factories fully on (furnace glow through roof vents, lit steam), sodium lamps, freight headlights; the well-7 shaft is the only daylight (cold white column and pool). Serves the dawn and day periods. Self-check s0.8 item 5 (dark pass). register / ship wait for the OBLIQUE-CODE step (maps.json views).  Queue order is enforced by depends: one batch at a time (D20); batches 1-9 in docs/tiancheng-maps.md s0.9.

items.title: Low oblique, night shift (D41)

Serves the dusk and night periods. register / ship wait for the OBLIQUE-CODE step (maps.json views). items.title: Estate exterior glb: a separable window / glass material for the night glow (D38)
items.notes: No render: stage final = evaluate (glb re-export only, same convention as estate:opt). The estate shell is one baked atlas today (m_house_shell) plus vertex-coloured details, so the web viewer has no material it can light at night; give the glazing its own material (e.g. m_win_glass) and list it in map/estate/model/manifest.json as x-night-glow. Keep the atlas budget and the low variant in step and bump manifest v. The night face mixes each material toward its own mid-tone, so a single-atlas exterior thins its roof / wall contrast after dark: a night keyframe in the bake, or one material per surface, keeps it. Engine side is ready (map/three/night-look.mjs: warm emissive on the named materials, hashed per floor so about a fifth of the windows stay dark); the estate3d probe check for lit window materials stays a known failure until this lands. Only what the model has as a fixture glows, no lamps outside. Self-check: the night exterior screenshot must show scattered lit windows, not one glowing plate (D35). Evidence while the engine half was built: ~/eden-map-review/estate-modes-1/house_{day,dusk,night}_desktop.png; tracked as Q-31 in docs/todo.md.
